title: I95 (= I46b): moving I46's E2 with the lead's rulings: the binding derived from code inside the pack, DISCH's budget in the brief, a generic clock-atom route, a fresh blind run

predictions.claim:
The binding row. A fresh run of `python -m holon binding --milestone M3` in the pack-only blind tree re-derives, by forge on the pinned checkout, a deployment record with the sha256 of the lead's committed gen/M3/binding/.json at

. There is one typed document (morph_rollup.extracted), and the row is reported beside the classes, not counted in blind_agreement.

E5 under both scorers. The preregistered scorer (_i46.calls_problems) flags at least one textual item, as in I46 (the brief's own config rewrite of the target path), so E5 is false under it. The amended reads scorer (_i46_reads.reads_problems, preregistered here) finds no problem, so E5 is true under it.
Matched classes under I82's metric: at least 189 M3 classes are matched (I46 matched 189; the binding may let the session derive more, such as SORT). M0, M1 and M2 match none (hand-written facts).

Agreement over the matched M3 classes. Per rule: PAR >= 0.99, SYM >= 0.95, DISCH >= 0.90, UNDO >= 0.85, FACT >= 0.80. Overall (I82's blind_agreement on M3) >= 0.95, so E2 holds. No class flips between PROVED and REFUTED.

The named laws. Of I46's 29 disagreements (thresholds.i46_disagreements, all lead-decided and blind UNKNOWN), at least 26 come into agreement: the 17 binding laws (SYM 9, UNDO 4, FACT 4: the searches start from the deployed contract, as the lead's do), the 8 search-budget DISCH laws (the brief's budget, depth 3 and 3000 prefixes), the 3 budget-and-clock DISCH laws (their witnesses come from the search), and L_disch_rev_rollup_363_e11d8bb2 (the route proves it over word clock arithmetic). The ones that may stay, and why, are in thresholds.may_stay. Of I46's 160 agreeing classes, at least 157 still agree.

The clock-atom route moves no lead verdict. At the base no lead M3 record carries the route's refusal, and the extension only handles forms the route refused. So every lead M3 DISCH record at the base keeps its status at

; the landing re-stamps M1/M2/T32 for the closure file, and the M3 DISCH records' generator stamps trail.

The exit, on I95's comparison: E1 true, E2 true, E3 false (convergence awaits external rounds), E4 false (the back-test gaps await a second finding and the human's L7 signature), and E5 false under the preregistered scorer but true under the amended one. The M3 exit is not met; I95's own clause (E2) is met.
